Octeka Mirror v1.5.0
Command-line interface and package manager for Octeka.Mirror.
Copyright (c) 2026 Patrick Robichaud (operating as OCTEKA). All rights reserved.
Usage: mirror [options] [command]

Commands:
  install         Installs one or more packages and deploys launcher stubs.
  update          Updates one or all installed applications.
  uninstall       Uninstalls an application stub and optionally removes unused
                  package versions.
  run             Runs an installed application or ad-hoc package specifier.
  list            Lists all installed applications and package versions.
  search          Searches configured package feeds.
  check-update    Checks whether a newer matching version is available for an
                  installed application.

Options:
  -h, --help           Show help and usage information.
  -nologo, --nologo    Suppress logo and banner output.
